name: Cross-Encoder Reranking
mechanism: Jointly encodes each query-passage pair and rescores a bounded first-stage candidate set before final evidence selection.
use_when: Required evidence appears in candidates but ranks too low
The latency budget supports pairwise relevance scoring
avoid_when: Candidate passages exceed the reranker input limit or required throughput
expected_effects: Higher relevance ordering within a fixed candidate set
failure_modes: Cannot recover evidence absent from candidates
Truncation hides the decisive span and latency scales with pairs
required_evals: p50 p95 latency throughput and cost
